items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Duke Ellington's out at the Dells or something, see? I said, 'Let's go out and hear him.'

ctx.x: I said, 'Have you eaten?' She said, 'No.' I said, 'Want to eat?' And she said, 'I haven't eaten.' I said, 'Well you're through singing, you can eat before you go to work.' She said, 'All right, fine.' I said, 'Let's go.' So we ate in the Sherman. And, I don't know we just got to talking. And I used to go out and hear Earl Hines and I knew -- I used to go and hear a lot of people all around town and she seemed to know what was happening as far as the clubs were concerned. We used to -- so we started -- I'd see her…
